blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 2.7
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 2.7

blocks.text: मातृकाचक्रसम्बोधः
blocks.directed: [slowly] मातृकाचक्रसम्बोधः

blocks.text: Mātṛkācakrasambodhaḥ.
blocks.directed: Mātṛkācakrasambodhaḥ.

blocks.text: Complete awakening to the circle of Mātṛkā.
blocks.directed: Complete awakening to the circle of Mātṛkā.

blocks.text: The Entire Sanskrit Alphabet Is a Secret Diagram of the Universe.
blocks.directed: The Entire Sanskrit Alphabet Is a Secret Diagram of the Universe.

blocks.text: Right.
blocks.directed: [short pause] Right.

blocks.text: Now we’re getting into the properly beautiful stuff.
blocks.directed: Now we’re getting into the properly beautiful stuff.

blocks.text: This is one of the most philosophically rich sūtras of the entire second section.
blocks.directed: This is one of the most philosophically rich sūtras of the entire second section.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja’s commentary goes absolutely nuclear.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja’s commentary goes absolutely nuclear.

blocks.text: We had three words.
blocks.directed: We had three words.

blocks.text: Mātṛkā.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Mātṛkā.

blocks.text: Cakra.
blocks.directed: Cakra.

blocks.text: Sambodha.
blocks.directed: Sambodha.

blocks.text: And he responds with an extraordinary exposition of the entire Sanskrit phonemic system as a manifestation of divine consciousness.
blocks.directed: And he responds with an extraordinary exposition of the entire Sanskrit phonemic system as a manifestation of divine consciousness.

blocks.text: Apparently the alphabet is not just the alphabet.
blocks.directed: Apparently the alphabet is not just the alphabet.

blocks.text: It’s a metaphysical procession of Śakti.
blocks.directed: It’s a metaphysical procession of Śakti.

blocks.text: Let’s unpack this.
blocks.directed: Let’s unpack this.

blocks.text: Mātṛkā — the little mother; here, the divine matrix of phonemic powers.
blocks.directed: Mātṛkā — the little mother; here, the divine matrix of phonemic powers.

blocks.text: Cakra — wheel, circle, collective.
blocks.directed: Cakra — wheel, circle, collective.

blocks.text: Sambodha — complete awakening, full understanding or recognition.
blocks.directed: Sambodha — complete awakening, full understanding or recognition.

blocks.text: In the preceding sūtra, the guru was introduced as the means.
blocks.directed: In the preceding sūtra, the guru was introduced as the means.

blocks.text: Now we learn what genuine instruction can disclose.
blocks.directed: Now we learn what genuine instruction can disclose.

blocks.text: The practitioner awakens to the true nature of Mātṛkā.
blocks.directed: The practitioner awakens to the true nature of Mātṛkā.

blocks.text: And this is where the entire discussion comes full circle.
blocks.directed: And this is where the entire discussion comes full circle.

blocks.text: Remember 1.4?
blocks.directed: Remember 1.4?

blocks.text: Jñānādhiṣṭhānaṃ mātṛkā.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Jñānādhiṣṭhānaṃ mātṛkā.

blocks.text: Mātṛkā is the foundation of differentiated knowledge.
blocks.directed: Mātṛkā is the foundation of differentiated knowledge.

blocks.text: Earlier, we encountered her as a power associated with bondage.
blocks.directed: Earlier, we encountered her as a power associated with bondage.

blocks.text: Now we’re encountering the exact same power as a vehicle of enlightenment.
blocks.directed: Now we’re encountering the exact same power as a vehicle of enlightenment.

blocks.text: Why?
blocks.directed: Why?

blocks.text: Because the letters are no longer apprehended merely as differentiated expressions concealing their source.
blocks.directed: Because the letters are no longer apprehended merely as differentiated expressions concealing their source.

blocks.text: They are recognised as expressions of supreme consciousness.
blocks.directed: They are recognised as expressions of supreme consciousness.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja unpacks this through a detailed tantric phonology.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja unpacks this through a detailed tantric phonology.

blocks.text: Let’s begin.
blocks.directed: Let’s begin.

blocks.text: अ — A
blocks.directed: [slowly] अ — A

blocks.text: The first vowel.
blocks.directed: The first vowel.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja associates a with Anuttara.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja associates a with Anuttara.

blocks.text: The unsurpassable.
blocks.directed: The unsurpassable.

blocks.text: That beyond which nothing is higher.
blocks.directed: That beyond which nothing is higher.

blocks.text: The supreme reality.
blocks.directed: The supreme reality.

blocks.text: Not simply a thing at the beginning of a sequence, but the fundamental source through which the entire sequence can be understood.
blocks.directed: Not simply a thing at the beginning of a sequence, but the fundamental source through which the entire sequence can be understood.

blocks.text: The alphabet begins with the unsurpassable.
blocks.directed: The alphabet begins with the unsurpassable.

blocks.text: Very ambitious for a vowel.
blocks.directed: Very ambitious for a vowel.

blocks.text: आ — Ā
blocks.directed: [slowly] आ — Ā

blocks.text: The extended vowel.
blocks.directed: The extended vowel.

blocks.text: Associated with Ānanda.
blocks.directed: Associated with Ānanda.

blocks.text: Bliss.
blocks.directed: Bliss.

blocks.text: The supreme reality understood through its own fullness and delight.
blocks.directed: The supreme reality understood through its own fullness and delight.

blocks.text: So the movement from a to ā is not simply interpreted as a longer sound.
blocks.directed: So the movement from a to ā is not simply interpreted as a longer sound.

blocks.text: It is given a symbolic meaning within the unfolding of consciousness.
blocks.directed: It is given a symbolic meaning within the unfolding of consciousness.

blocks.text: The unsurpassable and its bliss.
blocks.directed: The unsurpassable and its bliss.

blocks.text: इ — I, and ई — Ī
blocks.directed: [slowly] इ — I, and ई — Ī

blocks.text: Now we encounter icchā, will, and īśana, sovereignty or lordly power.
blocks.directed: Now we encounter icchā, will, and īśana, sovereignty or lordly power.

blocks.text: The divine doesn’t merely exist as an inert absolute.
blocks.directed: The divine doesn’t merely exist as an inert absolute.

blocks.text: It possesses the freedom to manifest.
blocks.directed: It possesses the freedom to manifest.

blocks.text: This is absolutely fundamental to Trika.
blocks.directed: This is absolutely fundamental to Trika.

blocks.text: If ultimate consciousness were entirely passive, we would have difficulty explaining manifestation as an expression of its own nature.
blocks.directed: If ultimate consciousness were entirely passive, we would have difficulty explaining manifestation as an expression of its own nature.

blocks.text: But Śiva is inseparable from Śakti.
blocks.directed: But Śiva is inseparable from Śakti.

blocks.text: And divine will belongs to that freedom.
blocks.directed: And divine will belongs to that freedom.

blocks.text: उ — U, and ऊ — Ū
blocks.directed: [slowly] उ — U, and ऊ — Ū

blocks.text: Now Kṣemarāja connects the phonemic unfolding with unmeṣa, opening or emergence, and ūnatā, a further differentiation associated with the developing appearance of objectivity.
blocks.directed: Now Kṣemarāja connects the phonemic unfolding with unmeṣa, opening or emergence, and ūnatā, a further differentiation associated with the developing appearance of objectivity.

blocks.text: The movement of manifestation becomes increasingly articulated.
blocks.directed: The movement of manifestation becomes increasingly articulated.

blocks.text: This is not ordinary physical chronology.
blocks.directed: This is not ordinary physical chronology.

blocks.text: We’re not claiming somebody pronounced a, then ā, and three seconds later the first galaxy appeared.
blocks.directed: We’re not claiming somebody pronounced a, then ā, and three seconds later the first galaxy appeared.

blocks.text: It is a symbolic, metaphysical account of the articulation of consciousness.
blocks.directed: It is a symbolic, metaphysical account of the articulation of consciousness.

blocks.text: The vowels represent powers through which manifestation is understood.
blocks.directed: The vowels represent powers through which manifestation is understood.

blocks.text: And the sequence continues.
blocks.directed: And the sequence continues.

blocks.text: ऋ, ॠ, ऌ, ॡ — ṛ, ṝ, ḷ, ḹ.
blocks.directed: [slowly] ऋ, ॠ, ऌ, ॡ — ṛ, ṝ, ḷ, ḹ.

blocks.text: These are connected with further differentiations involving the powers and their relations to elemental principles.
blocks.directed: These are connected with further differentiations involving the powers and their relations to elemental principles.

blocks.text: ए — E is associated with a particular union involving the powers symbolised by a and i.
blocks.directed: [slowly] ए — E is associated with a particular union involving the powers symbolised by a and i.

blocks.text: ओ — O is associated with the corresponding union involving a and u, connected with the emergence of the power of action.
blocks.directed: [slowly] ओ — O is associated with the corresponding union involving a and u, connected with the emergence of the power of action.

blocks.text: ऐ — Ai and औ — Au carry further symbolic meanings through combinations of those powers, including the integration of will, knowledge and action.
blocks.directed: [slowly] ऐ — Ai and औ — Au carry further symbolic meanings through combinations of those powers, including the integration of will, knowledge and action.

blocks.text: Then come the particularly important signs:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Then come the particularly important signs:

blocks.text: अं — Aṃ.
blocks.directed: [slowly] अं — Aṃ.

blocks.text: Bindu.
blocks.directed: Bindu.

blocks.text: The point of concentrated unity.
blocks.directed: The point of concentrated unity.

blocks.text: And:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And:

blocks.text: अः — Aḥ.
blocks.directed: [slowly] अः — Aḥ.

blocks.text: Visarga.
blocks.directed: Visarga.

blocks.text: The power of emission.
blocks.directed: The power of emission.

blocks.text: Now things become extraordinarily interesting.
blocks.directed: Now things become extraordinarily interesting.

blocks.text: Because the alphabet is associated with the movement between undivided consciousness and the manifestation of differentiated reality.
blocks.directed: Because the alphabet is associated with the movement between undivided consciousness and the manifestation of differentiated reality.

blocks.text: The consonants then receive their own metaphysical interpretations.
blocks.directed: The consonants then receive their own metaphysical interpretations.

blocks.text: The five consonantal classes, from ka through ma, are correlated with principles of manifestation.
blocks.directed: The five consonantal classes, from ka through ma, are correlated with principles of manifestation.

blocks.text: The semivowels:
blocks.directed: [short pause] The semivowels:

blocks.text: य र ल व — Ya, ra, la, va
blocks.directed: [slowly] य र ल व — Ya, ra, la, va

blocks.text: are associated with further intermediate levels, including the limiting powers.
blocks.directed: are associated with further intermediate levels, including the limiting powers.

blocks.text: The sibilants and ha are related to the higher movement between difference and non-difference.
blocks.directed: The sibilants and ha are related to the higher movement between difference and non-difference.

blocks.text: This is a structured tantric symbolism, not the ordinary linguistic explanation of how the Sanskrit alphabet historically developed.
blocks.directed: This is a structured tantric symbolism, not the ordinary linguistic explanation of how the Sanskrit alphabet historically developed.

blocks.text: And then Kṣemarāja introduces an absolutely magnificent idea.
blocks.directed: And then Kṣemarāja introduces an absolutely magnificent idea.

blocks.text: The Mahāmantra.
blocks.directed: The Mahāmantra.

blocks.text: The great mantra of I-consciousness.
blocks.directed: The great mantra of I-consciousness.

blocks.text: अहम् — Aham.
blocks.directed: [slowly] अहम् — Aham.
[short pause] “I.”

blocks.text: Now think about this.
blocks.directed: Now think about this.

blocks.text: The beginning of the alphabet.
blocks.directed: The beginning of the alphabet.

blocks.text: A.
blocks.directed: A.

blocks.text: The unfolding powers of Śakti.
blocks.directed: The unfolding powers of Śakti.

blocks.text: The sequence extending to ha and the concluding nasal element.
blocks.directed: The sequence extending to ha and the concluding nasal element.

blocks.text: The tradition reads this totality symbolically in the great expression:
blocks.directed: [short pause] The tradition reads this totality symbolically in the great expression:

blocks.text: Aham.
blocks.directed: Aham.

blocks.text: I.
blocks.directed: I.

blocks.text: But not merely the ordinary personal pronoun.
blocks.directed: But not merely the ordinary personal pronoun.

blocks.text: Not the limited ego saying:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Not the limited ego saying:

blocks.text: “I am hungry.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I am hungry.”

blocks.text: “I am tired.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I am tired.”

blocks.text: “I am better at metaphysics than my neighbour.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I am better at metaphysics than my neighbour.”

blocks.text: This is pūrṇāhantā.
blocks.directed: This is pūrṇāhantā.

blocks.text: Full I-consciousness.
blocks.directed: Full I-consciousness.

blocks.text: The universal Self-awareness of Śiva.
blocks.directed: The universal Self-awareness of Śiva.

blocks.text: The indivisible consciousness in which the entire manifest universe is included.
blocks.directed: The indivisible consciousness in which the entire manifest universe is included.

blocks.text: The great mantra is not merely a word used by an individual to refer to themselves.
blocks.directed: The great mantra is not merely a word used by an individual to refer to themselves.

blocks.text: It is an expression of the fundamental self-awareness of reality.
blocks.directed: It is an expression of the fundamental self-awareness of reality.

blocks.text: And now we can see the extraordinary elegance of the entire second section.
blocks.directed: And now we can see the extraordinary elegance of the entire second section.
[short pause] At 2.1:

blocks.text: The mind is mantra.
blocks.directed: The mind is mantra.
[short pause] At 2.3:

blocks.text: The secret of mantra is its living divine consciousness.
blocks.directed: The secret of mantra is its living divine consciousness.
[short pause] At 2.7:

blocks.text: The entire matrix of phonemic powers is recognised as a manifestation of that consciousness.
blocks.directed: The entire matrix of phonemic powers is recognised as a manifestation of that consciousness.

blocks.text: And the culmination is Aham.
blocks.directed: And the culmination is Aham.

blocks.text: Not the small, contracted “I”.
blocks.directed: Not the small, contracted “I”.

blocks.text: But the universal I-consciousness in which every sound, every object, every cognition, and every form of manifestation is included.
blocks.directed: But the universal I-consciousness in which every sound, every object, every cognition, and every form of manifestation is included.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja’s extensive discussion here draws on the phonemic cosmology of the Parātriṃśikā tradition and the teachings developed by Abhinavagupta. It’s far more elaborate than the three-word sūtra alone, but entirely relevant to the reading we’re following.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja’s extensive discussion here draws on the phonemic cosmology of the Parātriṃśikā tradition and the teachings developed by Abhinavagupta. It’s far more elaborate than the three-word sūtra alone, but entirely relevant to the reading we’re following.

blocks.text: And now, having realised that the alphabet is a manifestation of the Goddess, we’re ready for the next instruction.
blocks.directed: And now, having realised that the alphabet is a manifestation of the Goddess, we’re ready for the next instruction.

blocks.text: Which is, apparently:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Which is, apparently:

blocks.text: Throw your body into a fire.
blocks.directed: Throw your body into a fire.

blocks.text: Excellent.
blocks.directed: [short pause] Excellent.

blocks.text: Another perfectly normal day in Kashmir.
blocks.directed: Another perfectly normal day in Kashmir.
